utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, I've been a bit off lately... but I think the drive is Saturday, 9 AM at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, 9 AM on Saturday! I wrote that down somewhere... what were those supplies again?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I'm not sure either, Oren... maybe we can check the list together?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I'll bring a set of screwdrivers. See you Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, Leo, I appreciate the screwdrivers, but just to clarify—the repair drive is actually on Sunday, not Saturday. Hope that still works for you!

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks for the correction. Sunday works fine.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Faye, I think the repair drive is this Saturday at the community center, right?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Actually, the repair drive is today, not Saturday, and it's closing the main road near the school from 2 to 4 PM.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, right, today. Thanks for the heads up, Faye. I'll make sure to avoid that road.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Cleo, I've got a bunch of tools I can lend for the repair drive next Saturday. Just let me know what you need!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That's great, Gus! I'll add them to the list. I was just about to check what supplies we still need.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Mind if I come over and help you sort through the list? I've got the tools ready.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Oh, Nell, yes! The repair drive is this Saturday at 9 AM at the community center on Elm Street.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Actually, I think it's Sunday, not Saturday. Did the date change?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I'm certain it's Saturday, Mara. The flyer I saw clearly says Saturday at 9 AM.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Pia! I'm so excited about the repair drive today! Cleo asked me to check supplies; want to come along?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Wait, the repair drive is Sunday, Tess — remember? Are you sure it's today?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: What? No, I'm sure it's today! Cleo just asked me to help, it's definitely Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: It's at the community center on Elm Street, starting at 9 AM on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, I've got that noted. I'll be there at 9 AM on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Awesome, Opal! See you then—we're going to get a lot fixed up.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Huh? The repair drive? Oh, right, that's today? What's all this about delays at 3?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: The repair drive is Saturday at 9 AM at the Elm Street community center. What delays at 3 are you referring to?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, I thought it was from 2 to 4 in the afternoon. Maybe I mixed it up.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I think the repair drive is this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That's right! It's at 9 AM at the community center on Elm Street.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Great, I'll be there. What should I bring?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Dane, there's a repair drive this Saturday at 9 AM at the community center. Could you help spread the word?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure, Vik! I'll help spread the word. What time did you say it starts?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: 9 AM, at the community center. Thanks for your help!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, yes, I'm definitely planning to go! It's this Saturday at 9 AM at the community center, right? Are you going too, Jules?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I'll be there! Vik's been working hard organizing it, so I'm excited to pitch in. Want to help me spread the word?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely, I can mention it to a few folks I see around. Let's make sure everyone knows!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I'm not sure who's organizing, but I heard it's next Saturday from 2 to 4 PM.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Wait, I thought it was this Saturday at 9 AM. Are you sure about the time?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes, I'm pretty sure it's next Saturday, 2 to 4 PM. Maybe there's another event this Saturday at 9?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Kira, are you free this Saturday? There's a repair drive at the community center—could use some volunteers!

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: A repair drive? You sure that's not just some scheme?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It's legit, Kira. Some neighbors are fixing things for free. I'll be there too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hi Pia, I heard you're organizing a repair drive. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, thanks Rey! I'm a bit worried about managing the flow of items. Maybe you could help with sorting and checking people's items when they arrive?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, I can do that. What time should I be there?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Bo, I was just talking about the repair drive on Saturday. Are you planning to join?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Wait, I thought Tess said it was today? I'll check on that, but count me in for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, I'll see you on Saturday then!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Cleo, have you heard anything about a repair drive happening next Saturday? I keep hearing bits and pieces.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yeah, it's next Saturday! I'm keeping track of supplies. Need me to check what we've got left?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That'd be great, Cleo! I heard it's from 2 to 4, but I don't have the full list of what's needed yet.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Oren! The repair drive is this Saturday at the community center on Elm Street, starting at 9 AM. You should definitely come!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, 9 AM! Got it, I'll write it down this time. Thanks, Quinn!

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, Oren! Let me know if you need help with anything—maybe bring a tool you're good at fixing?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It's at the community center on Elm Street, starting at 9 AM this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh yes, that repair drive—it's closing the main road near the school from 2 to 4 PM, so we might need to adjust pickup times.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Good to know about the road closure; I'll update my map and we might need to shift the pickup window.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh yeah, I heard it's this Saturday at the community center. I might be a bit late, but I'll try to swing by.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Wait, I thought it was on Elm Street, not the community center. Or maybe I'm mixing things up again.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: No, it's definitely at the community center. I think you might be thinking of something else.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes, that's the one. I'll try to make it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great! Remember, it's this Saturday at 9 AM at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Right, 9 AM. I'll be there if I can.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I heard about it! I've got a bunch of tools I can lend, just let me know what you need.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That's great, Gus! I think they're looking for power tools and basic repair kits. You should drop by on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, I'll be there on Saturday with my tools!

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, I'm bringing a drill. It still works fine.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, that drill will come in handy. Have you thought about alternate pickup for the kids?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: We can pick them up before 2, that should work.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, Tess, the repair drive is this Saturday at 9 AM at the community center on Elm Street. I've got it on my calendar.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Actually, Eli, I think it's today, not Saturday. Just saw the flyer this morning.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Are you sure, Tess? I double-checked my calendar and it's definitely Saturday. Let me look at my notes again to be certain.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Mina! The repair drive is this Sunday at the community center. Can we count on you to join?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Actually, I heard it's on Saturday, not Sunday. And yes, I'll be there.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, I think there was a mix-up. It was moved to Sunday at the community center. Hope that works for you!
